header: 15 theme presets, switched without a rebuild
subheadline: Desiderio treats the look of your site as data that editors can change, not code that developers must deploy. The next rebrand is one setting.

items.title: 15 shadcn presets
items.description: Five presets from ui.shadcn.com/create and ten house presets, from Aurora to Citrus. Each has WCAG 2.2-checked contrast.

items.title: Per-page overrides
items.description: Set a preset in the page properties, and the page and all its subpages use it. Each campaign can have its own look.

items.title: Switch while the site runs
items.description: Change the preset and the site updates from its OKLCH tokens. There is no Tailwind rebuild and no deployment.
